Introduction
0:00
Welcome to this masterclass on IELTS band 7 plus academic vocabulary where we delve deeply into complex familial concepts.
Adolescence
0:10
The keyword is adolescence.
0:15
Definition: The transitional period of human psychological and physiological development that generally occurs during the period from puberty to legal adulthood, characterized by profound cognitive shifts, neurobiological maturation, and substantial emotional recalibration between childhood dependency and adult autonomy.
0:35
Example: Throughout the prolonged and turbulent phase of late adolescence, individuals frequently experience psychological friction with their parental guardians as they seek to establish their idiosyncratic identity within broader societal structures.
0:55
Collocations
1:00
Collocation: navigate through turbulent early adolescence in contemporary urban communities.
CTA
1:10
To solidify your active command of this sophisticated academic term, compose an extensive IELTS Task 2 body paragraph integrating the collocation and post it in the community discussion thread below for expert critique.
